name: Wren
description: A young adult with an androgynous light middle voice, a light Indian English accent, nimble precise consonants, and a thoughtful rhythm with small pauses. Warm, curious, and quietly confident. Natural conversational English. Clean studio recording.
purpose: A youthful voice with a distinct rhythm and gender presentation. Try a courier, a careful scholar, and a company leader.
text: The road is quiet this morning. Come inside, and tell me where you are going. We can find a place for your horses.
